note: Seeded from the field-group reference; Phase B lists every column of every sheet.

sheets.name: Hotels

columns.name: country_code
columns.meaning: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

columns.name: ld_id
columns.meaning: Lodgingeo place ID; stable across monthly releases.

columns.name: ld_name
columns.meaning: Name of the matched Lodgingeo place.

columns.name: ld_name_alt
columns.meaning: Alternative name of the matched place.

columns.name: ld_city
columns.meaning: City of the matched place.

columns.name: ld_address
columns.meaning: Address of the matched place.

columns.name: ld_category
columns.meaning: Category of the matched place.

columns.name: name_score
columns.meaning: Name similarity between your record and the match, 0–100.

columns.name: city_score
columns.meaning: City similarity between your record and the match, 0–100.

columns.name: confidence
columns.meaning: Match confidence: 70% name score, 30% city score, plus a small bonus for places typed as hotels.

columns.name: match_tier
columns.meaning: high, medium, low or no_match, derived from confidence.

columns.name: flags
columns.meaning: Notes on the match, such as a close second candidate.

columns.name: hotel_ld_id
columns.meaning: Lodgingeo ID of the hotel used for all fact columns.

columns.name: latitude
columns.meaning: Latitude, WGS84 decimal degrees.

columns.name: longitude
columns.meaning: Longitude, WGS84 decimal degrees.

columns.name: name
columns.meaning: Property name.

columns.name: name_alt
columns.meaning: Alternative or local-language name.

columns.name: parent_name
columns.meaning: Parent place or property group, where listed.

columns.name: street_address
columns.meaning: Street and number.

columns.name: neighborhood
columns.meaning: Neighbourhood or district.

columns.name: state
columns.meaning: State, province or region.

columns.name: postal_code
columns.meaning: Postal code.

columns.name: country_name
columns.meaning: Country name.

columns.name: formatted_address
columns.meaning: Full address on one line.

columns.name: timezone
columns.meaning: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Madrid.

columns.name: phone
columns.meaning: Phone number in international format.

columns.name: website
columns.meaning: Website URL as published by the property.

columns.name: domain
columns.meaning: Website domain without protocol or path.

columns.name: chain_from_website
columns.meaning: Chain or group detected from the website.

columns.name: brand
columns.meaning: Hotel brand, where known.

columns.name: wikipedia_url
columns.meaning: Wikipedia article, where one exists.

columns.name: category
columns.meaning: Primary category of the place.

columns.name: categories
columns.meaning: All categories of the place.

columns.name: status
columns.meaning: Operating status in the latest release.

columns.name: hotel_class
columns.meaning: Star class (1–5), where listed.

columns.name: rating
columns.meaning: Average guest rating.

columns.name: review_count
columns.meaning: Number of guest reviews.

columns.name: rating_distribution
columns.meaning: Count of reviews per star level.

columns.name: price_level
columns.meaning: Relative price level, where listed.

columns.name: check_in_time
columns.meaning: Check-in time.

columns.name: check_out_time
columns.meaning: Check-out time.

columns.name: amenities
columns.meaning: Amenities listed as available.

columns.name: amenities_unavailable
columns.meaning: Amenities listed as not available.

columns.name: attributes
columns.meaning: Other listed attributes.

columns.name: languages
columns.meaning: Languages spoken, where listed.

columns.name: floor_level
columns.meaning: Floor level of the place inside its building, where known.

columns.name: area_type
columns.meaning: Type of area around the place, where known.

columns.name: hotel_rate_latest
columns.meaning: Headline nightly rate in the latest release.

columns.name: hotel_rates_by_site
columns.meaning: Nightly offer per booking site in the latest release.

columns.name: booking_sites_latest
columns.meaning: Booking sites offering the hotel in the latest release.

columns.name: booking_otas_latest
columns.meaning: Online travel agencies among those sites.

columns.name: booking_metasearch_latest
columns.meaning: Metasearch sites among those sites.

columns.name: booking_other_sites_latest
columns.meaning: Other booking sites among those sites.

columns.name: lowest_offer_latest
columns.meaning: Lowest nightly offer across sites in the latest release.

columns.name: direct_offer_latest
columns.meaning: Offer on the hotel's own website, where shown.

columns.name: direct_vs_lowest_ota_pct
columns.meaning: Direct offer compared with the lowest OTA offer, in percent (positive: direct is higher).

columns.name: booking_sites_months_seen
columns.meaning: Months in which each booking site listed the hotel.

columns.name: rate_history_by_month
columns.meaning: Headline nightly rate per monthly release.

columns.name: hotel_avg_rate_2025
columns.meaning: Average of the monthly rates captured in 2025.

columns.name: hotel_avg_rate_2026
columns.meaning: Average of the monthly rates captured in 2026.

columns.name: places_inside_building
columns.meaning: Number of other places located inside the same building.

columns.name: contained_places_categories
columns.meaning: Categories of the places inside the building.

columns.name: building_id
columns.meaning: Building identifier from the source dataset.

columns.name: building_name
columns.meaning: Building name, where the source has one.

columns.name: polygon_source
columns.meaning: How the footprint was matched: overture_contains, osm_name or overture_nearest.

columns.name: building_area_m2
columns.meaning: Footprint area in square metres.

columns.name: building_polygon_wkt
columns.meaning: Building footprint as a WKT MULTIPOLYGON in WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

columns.name: building_match_grade
columns.meaning: Match confidence grade, A (highest) to E (lowest).

columns.name: building_match_score
columns.meaning: Numeric match score behind the grade.

columns.name: building_dist_m
columns.meaning: Distance from the hotel point to the building, in metres (0 when inside).

columns.name: building_osm_id
columns.meaning: OpenStreetMap ID of the building, where matched by name.

columns.name: building_osm_name
columns.meaning: OpenStreetMap name of the building.

columns.name: oldest_seen_date
columns.meaning: Earliest date the place is known to have been listed.

columns.name: first_seen_month
columns.meaning: First monthly release containing the hotel.

columns.name: last_seen_month
columns.meaning: Latest monthly release containing the hotel.

columns.name: last_confirmed_month
columns.meaning: Latest release in which the hotel was confirmed operating.

columns.name: closed_month
columns.meaning: Release in which the hotel was first marked closed.

columns.name: continuity_months
columns.meaning: Number of monthly releases containing the hotel.

columns.name: lifecycle_stage
columns.meaning: Lifecycle stage derived from the monthly history.

columns.name: rating_first
columns.meaning: Rating in the first release.

columns.name: rating_latest
columns.meaning: Rating in the latest release.

columns.name: rating_trend_12m
columns.meaning: Change in rating over the last 12 months.

columns.name: reviews_gained_last_month
columns.meaning: Reviews added since the previous release.

columns.name: reviews_gained_all_time
columns.meaning: Reviews added since the hotel was first seen.

columns.name: review_velocity_3m
columns.meaning: Average reviews gained per month over the last 3 months.

columns.name: status_history
columns.meaning: Operating status by month.

columns.name: name_history
columns.meaning: Previous names with the month they changed.

columns.name: facts_change_timeline
columns.meaning: Month-by-month list of changed facts.

columns.name: facts_changes_total
columns.meaning: Total number of fact changes since the first release.

columns.name: hotel_rating_change_2025
columns.meaning: Rating change during 2025.

columns.name: hotel_reviews_gained_2025
columns.meaning: Reviews gained during 2025.

columns.name: hotel_facts_changes_2025
columns.meaning: Fact changes during 2025.

columns.name: hotel_rating_change_2026
columns.meaning: Rating change during 2026.

columns.name: hotel_reviews_gained_2026
columns.meaning: Reviews gained during 2026.

columns.name: hotel_facts_changes_2026
columns.meaning: Fact changes during 2026.

columns.name: amenities_added
columns.meaning: Amenities added since the previous release (also amenities_removed, attributes_added/removed, languages_added/removed).

columns.name: nearest_<service>
columns.meaning: Name of the nearest place of a service type, e.g. nearest_pharmacy; nearest_<service>_m gives the distance in metres.

columns.name: count_<group>_3km
columns.meaning: Number of open places of a category group within 3 km.

columns.name: places_within_500m
columns.meaning: Open places within 500 m (also places_within_1km and places_within_3km).

columns.name: nearby_lodging_*
columns.meaning: Other places to stay nearby: the competitive set.

columns.name: nearby_openings_*
columns.meaning: Places that opened nearby, by period.

columns.name: nearby_closures_*
columns.meaning: Places that closed nearby, by period.

columns.name: neighbourhood_momentum_12m
columns.meaning: Balance of openings and closures nearby over 12 months.

columns.name: possible_replacements
columns.meaning: Places that may have replaced a closed place at the same spot.

columns.name: stable_recommendations_*
columns.meaning: Nearby places that stay highly rated across releases.

sheets.description: One row per hotel: match columns, then every fact column.

sheets.name: Category counts
sheets.description: Open places within 500 m, 1 km and 3 km of each hotel, per category.

sheets.name: Buildings
sheets.description: Building footprint per hotel: ID, name, source, area, grade, score, distance, OSM ID, polygon WKT.
